hypothesis: The thermodynamic instability of 2D crystals can be overcome by introducing curvature through rolling into nanotubes
prediction: The critical thickness for stable 2D carbon crystals will be greater when rolled into nanotubes compared to flat sheets
measurement_method: Measure the minimum stable layer thickness for both flat graphite sheets and carbon nanotubes using mechanical cleavage experiments
falsification_condition: If the critical thickness for nanotubes is less than or equal to that of flat sheets
